notes.title: MIND CORRIDORS: Augurium – OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=YX01O1w4FN8;full][/previewyoutube]

After 13 months since the release of MIND CORRIDORS: Paroniria, [b]MIND CORRIDORS: Augurium[/b], a [b][u]free expansion[/u][/b] as an update, is finally out!

[b]Featuring:[/b]
[list]
[*] New endings.
[*] New levels and creatures.
[*] A new lighting system with enhanced shadows.
[*] An official Korean translation.
[*] New secret mechanic.
[*] Slight changes and improvements in previous levels.
[/list]
[b]How can I access all of this in-game?[/b]
You can either press continue in the main menu if you have a completed playthrough, start a new game and try to open many times [b][i]the last door that opens[/i][/b] before the game's credits, or simply start a new game and re-discover the slight improvements in previous levels in case you have forgotten them.

notes.title: MIND CORRIDORS: Augurium - Coming out December 28th 2023
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=YX01O1w4FN8;full][/previewyoutube]

After 13 months since the release of MIND CORRIDORS: Paroniria, [b]MIND CORRIDORS: Augurium[/b], a [b][u]free update[/u][/b], will finally see the light of day next Thursday, December 28th.

[b]Featuring:[/b]
[list]
[*] A continuation to the game's ending.
[*] New levels and creatures.
[*] A new lighting system with enhanced shadows.
[*] An official Korean translation.
[*] New secret mechanic.
[*] Slight changes and improvements in previous levels.
[/list]
[b]How can I access all of this in-game?[/b]
Once the update is out, you can either press continue in the main menu if you have a completed playthrough, start a new game and try to open many times [b][i]the last door that opens[/i][/b] before the game's credits, or simply start a new game and re-discover the slight improvements in previous levels in case you have forgotten them.

notes.title: Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Now available on Steam, MIND CORRIDORS: Paroniria![/b][/h1]

[h2]How many of you will escape the eternal nightmare?[/h2]

It's been 2½ since the first concept art for this dark puzzle adventure was designed, from the developer Heartbyte Studios, and finally this journey concludes here... Or does it?

[b]Keep an eye out on future updates with new scares, rebalancing and more surprises![/b]
Don't be afraid of speaking out your feedback in the reviews!
